body:
## Why

The picture belongs where the tasks live. GitHub renders mermaid fenced blocks natively in issues and
comments, so `/kanban:decompose` can post the graph it is proposing and a reviewer sees a diagram
instead of an arrow list. Zero dependencies, roughly a string builder's worth of code, and it is
portable (Value 1) in a way a local web page is not.

This complements the drawer subgraph rather than replacing it: a copy-paste step does not answer "let
me see it while I work", which is why that one goes first.

## What

`hkb graph <n> [--mermaid] [--json]` — emit the track rooted at `<n>` as a graph.

- Reuse `resolveTrack` / `trackWaves` in `src/track.js`; do not re-walk the dependency graph by hand.
- `--mermaid` prints a fenced mermaid block ready to paste into an issue or a markdown file.
- `--json` returns `{ nodes, edges, mermaid }` — a stable object, like every other command.
- `/kanban:decompose`'s proposal comment includes the diagram.

**Two defects found in the prototype — fix them on the way in:**

- Label escaping neutralises `"` → `#quot;` but leaves `#` alone. A title containing `#123` renders as
  `{` — a silently wrong glyph, not a parse error. Escape `#` → `#35;` as well, and unit-test a title
  containing `#123`.
- Theme. `classDef todo fill:#64748b22,stroke:#64748b,color:#111` is near-black text on a 13%-alpha
  fill; GitHub uses a dark mermaid theme for dark-mode readers, so every label is unreadable there. Use
  theme-neutral classDefs, or none at all.

**Integration note.** `hkb comment` does not read stdin (`--from-stdin` is a global flag whose JSON keys
are fixed in `src/cli.js`, and the `comment` case never reads it). The form that works today is
`hkb comment 12 "$(hkb graph 12 --mermaid)"`. Either use that, or extend `comment` deliberately — do not
assume a stdin path exists.

## Done when

- `hkb graph <n> --mermaid` emits a valid fenced mermaid block for the track rooted at `<n>`.
- `--json` returns `{ nodes, edges, mermaid }`.
- A unit test covers a title containing `#123` and one containing `"`.
- classDefs are readable in both GitHub light and dark themes (or absent).
- `/kanban:decompose`'s comment step includes the diagram; `skills/kanban/references/protocol.md` and
  the README document the command.
- `npm run lint && npm test` green.
goal: hkb graph <n> --mermaid emits a fenced diagram GitHub renders in issues, and decompose posts it
title: hkb graph <n> --mermaid: the track as a diagram, where the tasks live
